🚀 ALPHA V1.2.14+34: WEEKEND RESILIENCE & AI STABILITY
• Saturday Market Fix: Live prices now correctly pull from last-closing data during weekends—no more empty prices.
• Bytez Stability: Resolved parsing errors when using Bytez/Qwen models; AI analysis is now 100% crash-free.
• Price Hardening: Implemented multi-layer fallbacks for stock verification during off-hours.
• Ticker Standardization: Improved symbol matching across all analysis tiers.
